Fully transparent background (PNG). No ground, no cast shadow, no text. Vertical 2:3, 1024x1536.

Six related items (doors, windows, signs or banners) in a 3x2 grid with clear transparent gaps between them so each can be sliced apart automatically, each item viewed straight-on, centered in its cell, consistent scale across the sheet. Fully transparent background (PNG). No text. 2048x1365.

A wide painted backdrop strip seen from far away: soft, hazy, no hard objects in the middle of the horizon, transparent sky above the skyline (PNG with alpha) so it can stand as a ring behind the zone, or a full sky panorama for the SKY rows. 2048x1024.

A distant skyline of flat-topped sandstone mesas and rock columns rising from a calm blue sea, layered by distance and hazy blue at the back, a few floating islands with grassy tops in a bright midday sky, wide panoramic strip, no foreground (the bottom fades to sea colour).
One dressed sandstone kerb stone, a long rounded block, slightly chipped.
